// Why this file exists: TensorFlow ships no type stubs (`py.typed`) for its nested module paths such as
Pylance therefore emits `reportMissingModuleSource` (severity 4 = hint) for every
such import, even though the imports resolve perfectly at runtime.
These are noise, not real errors: TensorFlow is installed and every script here runs.
// What we do instead: Turn off only `reportMissingModuleSource` (the unresolved-source-stub hint) while
leaving every other type check enabled, so genuine mistakes are still reported.
